real_multi.formula: 6 * 12 * 3 = 216; ceil(200/3)=67; same 72 bases are shared only where two valid slots exist

blender_single.formula: 3 buildings * 12 views * 17 names = 612; each building target 200 and 12*17=204

blender_multi.formula: 4 views * 38 distinct ordered name pairs = 152; 14 candidate names admit P(14,2)=182 pairs before geometry restrictions

blender_negative.formula: 40 views * 4 distinct negative scene choices = 160; ceil(150/4)=38; actual allowed combinations must be checked

capacity_calculation.notes: C(n,n)=1；不能把使用同一套素材的枚举顺序、微小调色或随机种子当额外基底。以上乘积均为计划上界，实用容量须对每个楼顶区域、槽位和标签的允许搭配求和；当前没有确认可训练的容量。
